_comment: SATELLITE: vir_extent->node-count->chi2 study (plan-v2 B6 / item 10). virialized Option A (lattice) GRF bounded+substep (MATCHED to core_v3 arm 05) with vir_extent_couples_nodes=true so vir_extent DRIVES the node count ~extent^3 (PF14): extent {1.0,1.5,2.0} -> {150,506,1200} nodes. vir_extent (and the coupling flag) are CONFIG-WIDE scalars in sweep.py, so each extent is its own arm. Small M grid {35,100}, S co-fit [3..35] ternary, 1000p/546 -- a SECONDARY shape study (the node-particle force is O(N_part x N_nodes), so extent=2.0 at 1200 nodes is the expensive end; 1000p keeps it tractable). Run via launch_sweep_detached.ps1 -IncludeSatellites.

arms.isolates: virA GRF bounded+substep | vir_extent=1.0 coupled -> 150 nodes (reference)
virA GRF bounded+substep | vir_extent=1.5 coupled -> 506 nodes
virA GRF bounded+substep | vir_extent=2.0 coupled -> 1200 nodes (expensive end)
